summary: Added PF_XATTRS and PF_XATTR_STREAM to xs-rs: xattr configuration negotiation, per-entry and per-file xattr lists, streamed large values with XXH3-64 verification, xattr filtering, and receiver-side set/remove. C++ clients and servers exchange user and rsync-internal attributes in both directions, including a second -XX pass.
diagnosis: Most work went into matching src/xattrs.cpp namespace rules (user.*, user.rsync.% internal names, -X versus -XX) and the remote.cpp framing: XATTR_CONFIG after compression, XATTR_START/CHUNK/END before the DIR/DATA that references them, and xattr fields after filter_source and after HLINK. Tests pin the exact list bytes and verify a 65 KiB streamed value round-trips with the C++ digest.
change: New rs/xs-rs/src/xattr.rs implements xattr reading/writing via llistxattr/lgetxattr/lsetxattr/lremovexattr, protocol list encoding/decoding, stream sender/receiver, namespace mapping and filters. Wired -X/--xattrs/--no-xattrs and -XX into CLI, HELLO feature advertisement and validation, XATTR_CONFIG handling, DIR entry and DATA attribute encoding/decoding, and receiver application for files, directories, links and special files. Added xattr filter predicates to FilterList.
expected_effect: xs-rs now interoperates with xs-c++ for extended attributes, including empty, binary and up-to-64 KiB values, internal namespaces on -XX, stale-attribute removal, and xattr filters. The framing matches C++ byte for byte; large values use the C++ stream format and digest.
risks: Linux-only as the case requires. Setting user.* attributes on symlinks can fail with EPERM, as on the reference platform. Itemized-change output does not yet mark xattr-only updates with 'x'. Push filters without --delete follow C++'s asymmetry where xattr-only rules are not sent to the receiver. Values above 64 KiB are covered by unit tests rather than filesystem integration because Linux filesystems cap one xattr near 64 KiB.
tests: Ran XS_BIN=~/benchmarks/lab/engineer/XR10210054-xattrs/parent/build/xs cargo test --manifest-path rs/Cargo.toml: all suites passed, including 4 new xattr interop tests and 5 xattr unit tests. Also passed cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --check, and cargo check --all-targets --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.
cpp_lesson: Nothing to change: xs-c++'s put_xattrs/get_xattrs, namespace rules and stream framing are correct and are followed byte for byte; the new code lives entirely under rs/.
commit_title: Port extended attributes and xattr value streams to xs-rs
commit_body: Implement PF_XATTRS and PF_XATTR_STREAM under rs/: CLI -X/-XX, HELLO negotiation, XATTR_CONFIG, list framing on DIR entries and DATA attributes, streamed values with XXH3-64 verification, namespace mapping and xattr filters. Add unit byte-parity tests plus C++ interop tests for push/pull, -XX internal names and filtered attributes.
